note: LA.30a: an ENUM owns its methods in the generic resolver (graph/src/calls.rs + build_symbol_table), exactly like a CLASS / STRUCT. Rust impl-on-enum methods are already METHOD children of the ENUM node, but enclosing_class_or_struct accepted only CLASS / STRUCT and class_methods indexed only CLASS / STRUCT children, so `self.weight()` inside `impl Tier` resolved nowhere. The Ledger pair is the control that resolves on HEAD.

expect_edges.note: self.weight() inside an enum impl: SelfMethod walks to the ENUM
control: the same shape on a struct resolves on HEAD

forbid.note: the enum's own weight(), never the same-named method of another type
indexing ENUM methods must not leak them into a struct's self-calls
